units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|name|259|0
units.english: Return to Kasii-Cavasaa-Oa
units.italian: Ritorna a Kasii-Cavasaa-Oa

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|description|260|0
units.english: Escort the Nnesa ti-a-Oj back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta il Nnesa ti-a-Oj fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|The <origin> spaceport is drenched when you arrive, deep in the throes of a massive rainstorm, its sail-like projections flapping in the wind and streaming with water. From your landing pad, a series of automated guides direct you to a hangar built into a circular depression in the ground; the top of it closes over like a bubble, translucent and disconcertingly springy against the elements. You can see the blurry silhouette of a Vujlet parked inside as you enter through the side door.|272|0
units.english: The <origin> spaceport is drenched when you arrive, deep in the throes of a massive rainstorm, its sail-like projections flapping in the wind and streaming with water. From your landing pad, a series of automated guides direct you to a hangar built into a circular depression in the ground; the top of it closes over like a bubble, translucent and disconcertingly springy against the elements. You can see the blurry silhouette of a Vujlet parked inside as you enter through the side door.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> è inzuppato quando arrivi, nel pieno di un temporale enorme, con le sue sporgenze simili a vele che sbattono al vento e grondano acqua. Dalla tua piazzola, una serie di guide automatiche ti indirizzano verso un hangar costruito dentro una depressione circolare nel terreno; la sua sommità si chiude come una bolla, traslucida e in modo inquietante elastica contro le intemperie. Entrando dalla porta laterale, vedi la sagoma sfocata di un Vujlet parcheggiato all'interno.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Near the entrance to the hangar, a data-sphere gently warbles, waiting for your touch. As you pick it up, it regurgitates its message:|273|0
units.english: Near the entrance to the hangar, a data-sphere gently warbles, waiting for your touch. As you pick it up, it regurgitates its message:
units.italian: Vicino all'ingresso dell'hangar, una sfera di dati gorgoglia piano, in attesa del tuo tocco. Quando la raccogli, rigurgita il suo messaggio:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Please bear well this craft, captain. Thou hast been an ally to us, and our own allies, this far, so Kaatrij offers thee this gift in amity. Use it well.|276|0
units.english: "Please bear well this craft, captain. Thou hast been an ally to us, and our own allies, this far, so Kaatrij offers thee this gift in amity. Use it well.
units.italian: "Abbi cura di questa nave, capitano. Sei stato un alleato per noi, e per i nostri stessi alleati, fin qui, così Kaatrij ti offre questo dono in amicizia. Usalo bene.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra."|277|0
units.english: This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra."
units.italian: Questo io stesso attesto, come K- I- Saajret, di Somber Sejra."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Apologies, dear captain, that I have not come to see thee in the flesh. Would that our allies in the New have been treating thee kindly, with all due openness and clarity. We offer this to thee, in amity. Use it well.|280|0
units.english: "Apologies, dear captain, that I have not come to see thee in the flesh. Would that our allies in the New have been treating thee kindly, with all due openness and clarity. We offer this to thee, in amity. Use it well.
units.italian: "Scuse, caro capitano, per non essere venuto a vederti di persona. Vorrei che i nostri alleati nel Nuovo ti abbiano trattato con gentilezza, con tutta la franchezza e la chiarezza dovute. Ti offriamo questo, in amicizia. Usalo bene.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra."|281|0
units.english: This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra."
units.italian: Questo io stesso attesto, come K- I- Saajret, di Somber Sejra."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	A single Successor emerges from the side of the craft; their outfit does not resemble that of an archivist so much as that of a soldier, with armor-woven fabrics and a kinetic rifle held at their side. "Captain <first> <last>?" they say, and when you confirm, continue, "I shall accompany thee as an observer."|283|0
units.english: A single Successor emerges from the side of the craft; their outfit does not resemble that of an archivist so much as that of a soldier, with armor-woven fabrics and a kinetic rifle held at their side. "Captain <first> <last>?" they say, and when you confirm, continue, "I shall accompany thee as an observer."
units.italian: Un solo Successore esce dal fianco della nave; il suo abito non somiglia a quello di un archivista quanto a quello di un soldato, con tessuti intessuti di corazza e un fucile cinetico tenuto al fianco. "Capitano <first> <last>?" dicono, e quando confermi continuano: "Ti accompagnerò come osservatore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"I was told to expect an archivist."|285|0
units.english: "I was told to expect an archivist."
units.italian: "Mi avevano detto di aspettarmi un archivista."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Very well."|286|0
units.english: "Very well."
units.italian: "Molto bene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Thine expectation is no longer accurate," they reply, not belying any emotion.|288|0
units.english: "Thine expectation is no longer accurate," they reply, not belying any emotion.
units.italian: "La tua aspettativa non è più accurata," rispondono, senza tradire alcuna emozione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	They show you onboard. The interior of Successor military ships looks much different from their civilian craft - the bridge is buried deep in the center of the craft under layers of armor, a small, circular room with a water-filled pool in the center and liquid-metal displays ringing the edges. Similarly compact living quarters and operational spaces fan out from it, each one well-equipped.|290|0
units.english: They show you onboard. The interior of Successor military ships looks much different from their civilian craft - the bridge is buried deep in the center of the craft under layers of armor, a small, circular room with a water-filled pool in the center and liquid-metal displays ringing the edges. Similarly compact living quarters and operational spaces fan out from it, each one well-equipped.
units.italian: Ti fanno strada a bordo. L'interno delle navi militari dei Successori è molto diverso dalle loro navi civili: la plancia è sepolta in profondità al centro della nave, sotto strati di corazza, una piccola stanza circolare con una vasca piena d'acqua al centro e display in metallo liquido che ne orlano il perimetro. Allo stesso modo, alloggi e spazi operativi compatti si aprono a ventaglio da lì, ciascuno ben attrezzato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	After you've had a look around, Kaatrij's observer escorts you off the vessel. "I and a Kaatrij crew shall pilot the vessel to Aqrabe. Once there, thou shouldst install thy jump drive aboard."|291|0
units.english: After you've had a look around, Kaatrij's observer escorts you off the vessel. "I and a Kaatrij crew shall pilot the vessel to Aqrabe. Once there, thou shouldst install thy jump drive aboard."
units.italian: Dopo che ti sei guardato intorno, l'osservatore di Kaatrij ti accompagna fuori dalla nave. "Io e un equipaggio di Kaatrij piloteremo la nave fino ad Aqrabe. Una volta lì, dovresti installare a bordo il tuo motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|dialog|294|0
units.english: You have returned to Kasii-Cavasaa-Oa, but the Vujlet you are escorting has not yet arrived.
units.italian: Sei tornato a Kasii-Cavasaa-Oa, ma il Vujlet che stai scortando non è ancora arrivato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|Both your ship and the Vujlet are directed to an enormous outfitting bay at <planet>'s spaceport, easily large enough for both craft ten times over. As you disembark, you notice several Successors are entering the landed Vujlet with large carts of equipment in tow, much of which is locked away in unmarked metallic cases. Notably, Kaatrij's representative remains onboard, keeping their distance from the Aqrabe ground crews. Tiliia spots you from an overhanging balcony and waves you over.|298|0
units.english: Both your ship and the Vujlet are directed to an enormous outfitting bay at <planet>'s spaceport, easily large enough for both craft ten times over. As you disembark, you notice several Successors are entering the landed Vujlet with large carts of equipment in tow, much of which is locked away in unmarked metallic cases. Notably, Kaatrij's representative remains onboard, keeping their distance from the Aqrabe ground crews. Tiliia spots you from an overhanging balcony and waves you over.
units.italian: Sia la tua nave sia il Vujlet sono indirizzati a un'enorme baia di allestimento nello spazioporto di <planet>, abbastanza grande per contenere dieci volte entrambe le navi. Mentre sbarchi, noti che diversi Successori stanno entrando nel Vujlet atterrato con grandi carrelli di attrezzature al seguito, molte delle quali chiuse in casse metalliche senza contrassegni. In particolare, il rappresentante di Kaatrij resta a bordo, tenendosi a distanza dagli equipaggi di terra di Aqrabe. Tiliia ti individua da un balcone sporgente e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"A lovely craft, is it not, Captain? Thou hast not flown one of our martial craft before, hast thou?."|299|0
units.english: "A lovely craft, is it not, Captain? Thou hast not flown one of our martial craft before, hast thou?."
units.italian: "Una bella nave, non è vero, capitano? Non hai mai pilotato una delle nostre navi da guerra, vero?."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"It was fascinating. It must be very efficient to command."|301|0
units.english: "It was fascinating. It must be very efficient to command."
units.italian: "È stato affascinante. Dev'essere molto efficiente da comandare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"A ship is a ship, really."|302|0
units.english: "A ship is a ship, really."
units.italian: "Una nave è una nave, in fondo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"It's not my first Successor craft, you know."|304|0
units.english: "It's not my first Successor craft, you know."
units.italian: "Non è la mia prima nave dei Successori, sai."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Tiliia hums briefly. "Such is the intention for all our warships," they say. "They are perhaps not as artful as they should be, but I suspect thou shalt find this craft as efficient as thou imaginest."|316|0
units.english: Tiliia hums briefly. "Such is the intention for all our warships," they say. "They are perhaps not as artful as they should be, but I suspect thou shalt find this craft as efficient as thou imaginest."
units.italian: Tiliia emette un breve ronzio. "Tale è l'intenzione per tutte le nostre navi da guerra," dicono. "Forse non sono artistiche quanto dovrebbero, ma sospetto che troverai questa nave efficiente quanto immagini."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Tiliia makes a short humming sound. "Perhaps," they say. "Thou shalt have the opportunity to decide for thyself soon enough."|319|0
units.english: Tiliia makes a short humming sound. "Perhaps," they say. "Thou shalt have the opportunity to decide for thyself soon enough."
units.italian: Tiliia emette un breve suono gorgogliante. "Forse," dicono. "Avrai presto l'occasione di deciderlo da te."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Tiliia ripples with an emotion that's difficult to place; its colors seem to hint of pride and satisfaction.|322|0
units.english: Tiliia ripples with an emotion that's difficult to place; its colors seem to hint of pride and satisfaction.
units.italian: Tiliia ondeggia di un'emozione difficile da collocare; i suoi colori sembrano alludere a orgoglio e soddisfazione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	The re-armoring process begins soon after, massive metallic arms folding down from the top of the bay to scan over the surface of the ship. At certain points, flying drones emerge from the sides of the hangar to dispense some additional material onto the vessel or to perform scans, projecting shape after shape onto the warbling hull in many-colored laser light. After a while of watching, Tiliia leans over to you. "The process will take some more hours," they say. "The armor to cross the wormhole is a more complicated kind than the others. I'll leave thee to thine own pursuits for now - though, I plan to go among the statue garden for a while, and if it pleases thee, thou mayst join me there."|324|0
units.english: The re-armoring process begins soon after, massive metallic arms folding down from the top of the bay to scan over the surface of the ship. At certain points, flying drones emerge from the sides of the hangar to dispense some additional material onto the vessel or to perform scans, projecting shape after shape onto the warbling hull in many-colored laser light. After a while of watching, Tiliia leans over to you. "The process will take some more hours," they say. "The armor to cross the wormhole is a more complicated kind than the others. I'll leave thee to thine own pursuits for now - though, I plan to go among the statue garden for a while, and if it pleases thee, thou mayst join me there."
units.italian: Il processo di nuova corazzatura comincia poco dopo, con enormi braccia metalliche che si piegano giù dalla sommità della baia per scansionare la superficie della nave. In certi momenti, droni in volo escono dai lati dell'hangar per depositare altro materiale sulla nave o per eseguire scansioni, proiettando forma dopo forma sullo scafo gorgogliante con luce laser multicolore. Dopo un po' che guardi, Tiliia si china verso di te. "Il processo richiederà ancora qualche ora," dicono. "La corazza per attraversare il wormhole è di un tipo più complicato delle altre. Per ora ti lascio ai tuoi impegni... anche se conto di passare un po' di tempo nel giardino di statue, e se ti fa piacere puoi unirti a me lì."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"I'd be happy to."|326|0
units.english: "I'd be happy to."
units.italian: "Ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Thanks, but I have my own preparations to make."|327|0
units.english: "Thanks, but I have my own preparations to make."
units.italian: "Grazie, ma ho i miei preparativi da fare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|log|330|0
units.english: People
units.italian: People

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	The statue garden isn't very far from the outfitting bay where the Vujlet is parked. It's a circular area, cut out of the structure of the spaceport and exposed to the elements - the early-morning light shines through the light snowfall and glitters on the eerie metallic forms of the statues. Most of them are purely abstract, but one in every ten or so has some organic form emerging from the smooth metal as if it were trapped behind a sheet: leaves of plants, faces of animals, or even what look like Successor body parts.|331|0
units.english: The statue garden isn't very far from the outfitting bay where the Vujlet is parked. It's a circular area, cut out of the structure of the spaceport and exposed to the elements - the early-morning light shines through the light snowfall and glitters on the eerie metallic forms of the statues. Most of them are purely abstract, but one in every ten or so has some organic form emerging from the smooth metal as if it were trapped behind a sheet: leaves of plants, faces of animals, or even what look like Successor body parts.
units.italian: Il giardino di statue non è molto lontano dalla baia di allestimento dove è parcheggiato il Vujlet. È uno spazio circolare, ricavato nella struttura dello spazioporto ed esposto alle intemperie: la luce del primo mattino splende attraverso la nevicata leggera e scintilla sulle forme metalliche inquietanti delle statue. La maggior parte è puramente astratta, ma una su dieci circa ha qualche forma organica che emerge dal metallo liscio come se fosse intrappolata dietro un velo: foglie di piante, volti di animali, o perfino quelli che sembrano pezzi del corpo di un Successore.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"I'm curious, captain," Tiliia says. "What motivates thee to do this? Flying into a star, I mean to say. Last we visited, 'twas on thine own ship that thou knowest well - now, thou placest thy life in alien engineering thou hast never seen perform. Why consider it?"|332|0
units.english: "I'm curious, captain," Tiliia says. "What motivates thee to do this? Flying into a star, I mean to say. Last we visited, 'twas on thine own ship that thou knowest well - now, thou placest thy life in alien engineering thou hast never seen perform. Why consider it?"
units.italian: "Sono curioso, capitano," dice Tiliia. "Che cosa ti motiva a fare questo? Entrare in una stella, voglio dire. L'ultima volta che ci siamo visti, eri sulla tua nave, che conosci bene; ora metti la tua vita in un'ingegneria aliena che non hai mai visto all'opera. Perché prenderla in considerazione?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"I've done other dangerous things before and they've always worked out."|334|0
units.english: "I've done other dangerous things before and they've always worked out."
units.italian: "Ho fatto altre cose pericolose, e sono sempre andate bene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"I've seen enough of Successor engineering to be confident in it."|336|0
units.english: "I've seen enough of Successor engineering to be confident in it."
units.italian: "Ho visto abbastanza ingegneria dei Successori da fidarmene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Maybe I like the danger."|338|0
units.english: "Maybe I like the danger."
units.italian: "Forse mi piace il pericolo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Danger, danger," Tiliia says, rolling the word around in their mouth. "Our youths will dream of being valiant pilots, proving their valor in strings of peril, and then in adulthood instead awake to find themselves at the helm of a cargo ship disguised as something diff'rent by House armor. Perhaps I understand that for thee, captain."|339|0
units.english: "Danger, danger," Tiliia says, rolling the word around in their mouth. "Our youths will dream of being valiant pilots, proving their valor in strings of peril, and then in adulthood instead awake to find themselves at the helm of a cargo ship disguised as something diff'rent by House armor. Perhaps I understand that for thee, captain."
units.italian: "Pericolo, pericolo," dice Tiliia, rigirando la parola in bocca. "I nostri giovani sogneranno di essere piloti valorosi, di dimostrare il loro valore in catene di pericoli, e poi da adulti si sveglieranno invece al comando di una nave da carico travestita da qualcos'altro dalla corazza di Casa. Forse questo lo capisco, per te, capitano."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	A mirthful blush passes over Tiliia. "No doubt thou hast," they say. "To've traveled as far as thou hast, through such perilous voids... let us hope thy luck holds, then, captain."|342|0
units.english: A mirthful blush passes over Tiliia. "No doubt thou hast," they say. "To've traveled as far as thou hast, through such perilous voids... let us hope thy luck holds, then, captain."
units.italian: Un rossore divertito passa su Tiliia. "Senza dubbio l'hai fatto," dicono. "Per aver viaggiato lontano come hai fatto, attraverso vuoti così pericolosi... speriamo che la tua fortuna regga, allora, capitano."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Truly?" Tiliia says. They look around at the sculptures, taking them in. "That's fair for thee. We may not be what we were long ago, but we do retain some subtle arts. Thou'rt right, if it matters, to trust us in this. Nothing endures as long as we have by being fickle."|345|0
units.english: "Truly?" Tiliia says. They look around at the sculptures, taking them in. "That's fair for thee. We may not be what we were long ago, but we do retain some subtle arts. Thou'rt right, if it matters, to trust us in this. Nothing endures as long as we have by being fickle."
units.italian: "Davvero?" dice Tiliia. Si guardano intorno fra le sculture, osservandole. "È giusto per te. Forse non siamo più quello che eravamo molto tempo fa, ma conserviamo ancora alcune arti sottili. Hai ragione, se conta, a fidarti di noi in questo. Nulla dura quanto noi se non essendo volubile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"And you," you ask, "why are you doing this?"|347|0
units.english: "And you," you ask, "why are you doing this?"
units.italian: "E tu," chiedi, "perché lo fai?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Tiliia hums a long drone as they contemplate. "We've a tradition here - at least at Aqrabe, but I know others've sim'lar ones, too. In the late hour of their life, a parent's children will decide for them a task they are t'accomplish: a work of art to make, a journey to travel, a change of the self to effect, or another of that sort. Much of our lives are formed already by the acts and station of our ancestors, so 'tis fair t'offer some shaping to our progeny in return."|348|0
units.english: Tiliia hums a long drone as they contemplate. "We've a tradition here - at least at Aqrabe, but I know others've sim'lar ones, too. In the late hour of their life, a parent's children will decide for them a task they are t'accomplish: a work of art to make, a journey to travel, a change of the self to effect, or another of that sort. Much of our lives are formed already by the acts and station of our ancestors, so 'tis fair t'offer some shaping to our progeny in return."
units.italian: Tiliia emette un ronzio lungo mentre riflettono. "Abbiamo una tradizione, qui... almeno a Aqrabe, ma so che altri ne hanno di simili. Nell'ultima ora della loro vita, i figli di un genitore decidono per loro un compito da portare a termine: un'opera d'arte da fare, un viaggio da compiere, un cambiamento di sé da realizzare, o un'altra cosa del genere. Gran parte della nostra vita è già formata dagli atti e dal rango dei nostri antenati, quindi è giusto offrire un po' di forma alla nostra discendenza in cambio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"So your children are asking you to fly into a star?"|349|0
units.english: "So your children are asking you to fly into a star?"
units.italian: "Quindi i tuoi figli ti stanno chiedendo di volare dentro una stella?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	An explosion of humor consumes Tiliia, and they lean against one of the statues for support. "No, no," they say, "I'm far too young, and 'twouldn't be the right thing to ask, besides. No, I mention it because the task I decided for my eldest parent is this around us." They gesture to the sculptures. "For ten years they formed the pillars standing here and now, even dead, a bit of their existence lingers 'tween those, and in the air. If we succeed, then likewise parts of us shall live in the future of this House."|350|0
units.english: An explosion of humor consumes Tiliia, and they lean against one of the statues for support. "No, no," they say, "I'm far too young, and 'twouldn't be the right thing to ask, besides. No, I mention it because the task I decided for my eldest parent is this around us." They gesture to the sculptures. "For ten years they formed the pillars standing here and now, even dead, a bit of their existence lingers 'tween those, and in the air. If we succeed, then likewise parts of us shall live in the future of this House."
units.italian: Un'esplosione di ilarità travolge Tiliia, che si appoggiano a una delle statue per sostenersi. "No, no," dicono, "sono fin troppo giovane, e non sarebbe comunque la cosa giusta da chiedere. No, lo dicevo perché il compito che ho deciso per il mio genitore maggiore è questo intorno a noi." Indicano le sculture. "Per dieci anni hanno formato i pilastri che stanno qui, e ora, anche morti, un po' della loro esistenza indugia fra quelli, e nell'aria. Se riusciremo, allora allo stesso modo parti di noi vivranno nel futuro di questa Casa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"I can understand wanting to make a difference."|352|0
units.english: "I can understand wanting to make a difference."
units.italian: "Capisco il desiderio di fare la differenza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Do you really think the scions of the House will be that grateful?"|354|0
units.english: "Do you really think the scions of the House will be that grateful?"
units.italian: "Pensi davvero che gli eredi della Casa saranno così riconoscenti?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"'Tisn't about gratitude, nor about the scions. 'Tis a matter of... continuity. Our lives are waves upon the bright shore, shaped by predecessors, shaping consequents. Over the eons, names become words in the common language, and are then chosen again as names as new children become adults. In a thousand years, thy name may become the word for those 'keystones' of thine, and in a thousand more, it could be invoked by a new cohort in a new world."|355|0
units.english: "'Tisn't about gratitude, nor about the scions. 'Tis a matter of... continuity. Our lives are waves upon the bright shore, shaped by predecessors, shaping consequents. Over the eons, names become words in the common language, and are then chosen again as names as new children become adults. In a thousand years, thy name may become the word for those 'keystones' of thine, and in a thousand more, it could be invoked by a new cohort in a new world."
units.italian: "Non si tratta di gratitudine, né degli eredi. È una questione di... continuità. Le nostre vite sono onde sulla riva luminosa, plasmate dai predecessori, che plasmano i conseguenti. Nel corso degli eoni, i nomi diventano parole nella lingua comune, e poi vengono scelti di nuovo come nomi quando nuovi figli diventano adulti. Fra mille anni, il tuo nome potrebbe diventare la parola per quelle tue 'pietre chiave', e fra altri mille potrebbe essere invocato da una nuova schiera in un mondo nuovo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"That seems a little far-fetched."|357|0
units.english: "That seems a little far-fetched."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un po' inverosimile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"I wouldn't mind that."|359|0
units.english: "I wouldn't mind that."
units.italian: "Non mi dispiacerebbe."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Sometimes I worry they'll be invoking it as a curse. The Successors haven't done right by everyone, after all."|361|0
units.english: "Sometimes I worry they'll be invoking it as a curse. The Successors haven't done right by everyone, after all."
units.italian: "A volte temo che lo invocheranno come una maledizione. I Successori non si sono comportati bene con tutti, dopo tutto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Tiliia looks down at you with interest. "Perhaps I guess what thou mean'st, but tell me more, if it pleases thee."|366|0
units.english: Tiliia looks down at you with interest. "Perhaps I guess what thou mean'st, but tell me more, if it pleases thee."
units.italian: Tiliia ti guarda con interesse. "Forse immagino che cosa intendi, ma dimmi di più, se ti fa piacere."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Well," you say, "the People's Houses don't seem happy with their lot, and the Predecessor planets that I've seen don't look very comfortable. Not that humans don't have our own problems, but it seems like even thousands of years of 'waves upon the bright shore' haven't made the Successors totally enlightened. Supplying you with keystones might help us both right now, but who knows what'll come of it in the future?"|367|0
units.english: "Well," you say, "the People's Houses don't seem happy with their lot, and the Predecessor planets that I've seen don't look very comfortable. Not that humans don't have our own problems, but it seems like even thousands of years of 'waves upon the bright shore' haven't made the Successors totally enlightened. Supplying you with keystones might help us both right now, but who knows what'll come of it in the future?"
units.italian: "Beh," dici, "le Casate del Popolo non sembrano felici della loro sorte, e i pianeti dei Predecessori che ho visto non sembrano molto confortevoli. Non che gli umani non abbiano i propri problemi, ma sembra che nemmeno migliaia di anni di 'onde sulla riva luminosa' abbiano reso i Successori del tutto illuminati. Fornirvi delle pietre chiave potrebbe aiutare noi due adesso, ma chissà che cosa ne verrà in futuro?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	A spark of anger flashes over Tiliia's face, but only briefly, and they seem to push their skin back to its most neutral color. "There's no undoing what's already wrought," they say. "Sad as it might be." They pause for a moment. "I'll hope to see thee in the spaceport nonetheless, captain."|368|0
units.english: A spark of anger flashes over Tiliia's face, but only briefly, and they seem to push their skin back to its most neutral color. "There's no undoing what's already wrought," they say. "Sad as it might be." They pause for a moment. "I'll hope to see thee in the spaceport nonetheless, captain."
units.italian: Una scintilla di rabbia guizza sul volto di Tiliia, ma solo per un attimo, e sembrano riportare la pelle al suo colore più neutro. "Non si può disfare ciò che è già compiuto," dicono. "Per triste che sia." Si fermano un momento. "Spero comunque di vederti allo spazioporto, capitano."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Mirth once again sparkles Tiliia's skin. "Probably so," they say, and after a pause, "my thanks to thee for joining me, captain. Thou shouldst prepare now - join us back at the spaceport when thou'rt ready."|371|0
units.english: Mirth once again sparkles Tiliia's skin. "Probably so," they say, and after a pause, "my thanks to thee for joining me, captain. Thou shouldst prepare now - join us back at the spaceport when thou'rt ready."
units.italian: L'ilarità torna a scintillare sulla pelle di Tiliia. "Probabilmente sì," dicono, e dopo una pausa: "grazie per esserti unito a me, capitano. Ora dovresti prepararti: raggiungici allo spazioporto quando sei pronto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	Tiliia keeps a contemplative look on their face. "Somehow I suspected that," they say, and after a pause, "my thanks to thee for joining me, captain. Thou shouldst prepare now - join us back at the spaceport when thou'rt ready."|374|0
units.english: Tiliia keeps a contemplative look on their face. "Somehow I suspected that," they say, and after a pause, "my thanks to thee for joining me, captain. Thou shouldst prepare now - join us back at the spaceport when thou'rt ready."
units.italian: Tiliia mantiene un'espressione pensosa. "In qualche modo lo sospettavo," dicono, e dopo una pausa: "grazie per esserti unito a me, capitano. Ora dovresti prepararti: raggiungici allo spazioporto quando sei pronto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"It's quite a feeling," they say, "isn't it?" They pause for a short while, looking up at the sky. The clouds overhead are starting to part and the snowfall is thinning. You notice for the first time that the ground is slightly heated - none of the snow that's falling has accumulated, instead just melting away into tiny channels in the rock. "My thanks to thee for joining me, captain," says Tiliia. "Thou shouldst prepare now - join us back at the spaceport when thou'rt ready."|377|0
units.english: "It's quite a feeling," they say, "isn't it?" They pause for a short while, looking up at the sky. The clouds overhead are starting to part and the snowfall is thinning. You notice for the first time that the ground is slightly heated - none of the snow that's falling has accumulated, instead just melting away into tiny channels in the rock. "My thanks to thee for joining me, captain," says Tiliia. "Thou shouldst prepare now - join us back at the spaceport when thou'rt ready."
units.italian: "È una bella sensazione," dicono, "vero?" Si fermano per un po', guardando il cielo. Le nuvole sopra cominciano ad aprirsi e la nevicata si dirada. Noti per la prima volta che il terreno è leggermente riscaldato: nessuna della neve che cade si è accumulata, si scioglie invece in piccoli canali nella roccia. "Grazie per esserti unito a me, capitano," dice Tiliia. "Ora dovresti prepararti: raggiungici allo spazioporto quando sei pronto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	"Of course. Join me back here in the spaceport, then, four hours hence."|380|0
units.english: "Of course. Join me back here in the spaceport, then, four hours hence."
units.italian: "Certo. Raggiungimi qui allo spazioporto, allora, fra quattro ore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 5|	With that, Tiliia heads off. You should make sure that the Vujlet you have been loaned is equipped for the upcoming voyage.|382|0
units.english: With that, Tiliia heads off. You should make sure that the Vujlet you have been loaned is equipped for the upcoming voyage.
units.italian: Detto questo, Tiliia si avvia. Dovresti assicurarti che il Vujlet che ti è stato prestato sia attrezzato per il viaggio che vi aspetta.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|name|385|0
units.english: Visit exotic metal garden again
units.italian: Visita di nuovo il giardino di metallo esotico

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|description|386|0
units.english: Attempt a landing on the <system> stellar metal garden using the modified Vujlet.
units.italian: Tenta un atterraggio sul giardino di metallo stellare di <system> usando il Vujlet modificato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|blocked|393|0
units.english: You will need <capacity> to bring back enough stellar metal from <destination>.
units.italian: Ti servirà <capacity> per riportare abbastanza metallo stellare da <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|You meet Tiliia and House Kaatrij's observer back in the hangar bay with the specially-equipped Vujlet, which now gleams all over with an oily, iridescent sheen. Tiliia and the observer are in the middle of a heated conversation; you catch a bit of something ending "...foolish to trust an alien," from the observer.|396|0
units.english: You meet Tiliia and House Kaatrij's observer back in the hangar bay with the specially-equipped Vujlet, which now gleams all over with an oily, iridescent sheen. Tiliia and the observer are in the middle of a heated conversation; you catch a bit of something ending "...foolish to trust an alien," from the observer.
units.italian: Incontri Tiliia e l'osservatore di Casa Kaatrij nella baia dell'hangar, con il Vujlet attrezzato appositamente, che ora riluce ovunque di un lustro oleoso e iridescente. Tiliia e l'osservatore sono nel mezzo di una conversazione accesa; senti un pezzo di frase che finisce con "...sciocco fidarsi di un alieno," pronunciata dall'osservatore.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|	Tiliia waves you over. "Good, captain. Our ally was just expressing the importance of thy promptness in this task. Kaatrij longs not to be parted from their trinket for long."|397|0
units.english: Tiliia waves you over. "Good, captain. Our ally was just expressing the importance of thy promptness in this task. Kaatrij longs not to be parted from their trinket for long."
units.italian: Tiliia ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. "Bene, capitano. Il nostro alleato stava appena esprimendo l'importanza della tua puntualità in questo compito. Kaatrij non desidera restare a lungo separato dal suo ninnolo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|	"Fine," you say. "Anything else I need to know?"|398|0
units.english: "Fine," you say. "Anything else I need to know?"
units.italian: "Bene," dici. "C'è altro che devo sapere?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|	The observer looks you over with an emotionless gaze. "Our efforts shall protect the craft from the star's heat, but little else. 'T'would be wise not to linger in the Tangles."|399|0
units.english: The observer looks you over with an emotionless gaze. "Our efforts shall protect the craft from the star's heat, but little else. 'T'would be wise not to linger in the Tangles."
units.italian: L'osservatore ti scruta con uno sguardo senza emozioni. "I nostri sforzi proteggeranno la nave dal calore della stella, ma poco altro. Sarebbe saggio non indugiare nei Tangles."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 6|	Tiliia rubs their arms together and a pulse of electric blue passes over them. "Time to go, then, captain!"|400|0
units.english: Tiliia rubs their arms together and a pulse of electric blue passes over them. "Time to go, then, captain!"
units.italian: Tiliia si strofina le braccia e un impulso di blu elettrico le attraversa. "È ora di andare, allora, capitano!"
